bolt-strike.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to paralyze the target.
bolt-strike.flavor: The user surrounds itself with a great amount of electricity and charges the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

bone-club.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to make the target flinch.
bone-club.flavor:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

bone-rush.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times.  Averages to 3 hits per use.
bone-rush.flavor: The user attacks by striking the target with a hard bone. This move hits two to five times in a row.

bonemerang.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Hits twice in one turn.
bonemerang.flavor:
The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops
around to hit the target twice—coming and going.

boomburst.flavor: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible explosive sound.

bounce.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  User bounces high into the air for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.  Has a chance to paralyze the target.

During the immune turn, Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thunder, and Twister still hit the user normally.  Gust and Twister also have double power against the user.

The damage from Hail and Sandstorm still applies during the immune turn.

The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard.

This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.
bounce.flavor: The user bounces up high on the first turn, then drops onto the target on the next turn. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

bouncy-bubble.flavor:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

branch-poke.flavor: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.

brave-bird.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
brave-bird.flavor: The user tucks in its wings and charges at a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.

breaking-swipe.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
breaking-swipe.flavor: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.

brick-break.effect: Destroys any Light Screen or Reflect on the target’s side of the field, then inflicts regular damage.
brick-break.flavor: The user attacks with a swift chop. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

brine.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target has less than half its max HP remaining, this move has double power.
brine.flavor: This move's power is doubled if the target's HP is at half or less.

brutal-swing.flavor: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

bubble.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
bubble.flavor:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.

bubble-beam.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
bubble-beam.flavor: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. This may also lower the target's Speed stat.

bug-bite.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the target is holding a berry, this move has double power, and the user takes the berry and uses it immediately.

If the target is holding a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect.

If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move’s damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen.
bug-bite.flavor: The user attacks by biting the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

bug-buzz.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
bug-buzz.flavor: The user vibrates to generate a damaging sound wave. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

bulk-up.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage each.
bulk-up.flavor: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.

bulldoze.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
bulldoze.flavor: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

bullet-punch.flavor: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.

bullet-seed.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times.  Averages to 3 hits per use.
bullet-seed.flavor: The user attacks by forcefully shooting seeds at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.

burn-up.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Removes the user’s Fire type after damage calculation.  If the user is not Fire-type, this move will fail.
burn-up.flavor:
To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out.
After using this move, the user will no longer be
Fire type.

burning-bulwark.flavor: The user's intensely hot fur protects it from attacks and also burns any attacker that makes direct contact with it.

burning-jealousy.effect: Burns the target if it had a state stage raise this turn.
burning-jealousy.flavor: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.

buzzy-buzz.flavor:
This move can’t be used.

Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

calm-mind.effect: Raises the user’s Special Attack and Special Defense by one stage each.
calm-mind.flavor: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

ceaseless-edge.flavor: The user slashes its shell blade at the target. Shell splinters left behind by this attack remain scattered under the target as spikes.

celebrate.flavor: The Pokémon congratulates you on your special day!

charge.effect: Raises the user’s Special Defense by one stage.  If the user uses an Electric move next turn, its power will be doubled.
charge.flavor: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

charge-beam.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.
charge-beam.flavor: The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The residual electricity may also boost the user's Sp. Atk stat.

charm.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.
charm.flavor: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.

chatter.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Has either a 1%, 11%, or 31% chance to confuse the target, based on the volume of the recording made for this move; louder recordings increase the chance of confusion.  If the user is not a Chatot, this move will not cause confusion.

This move cannot be copied by Mimic, Mirror Move, or Sketch, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.
chatter.flavor:
The user attacks the target with sound waves of
deafening chatter. This confuses the target.

chilling-water.flavor: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

chilly-reception.flavor: The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.

chip-away.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Damage calculation ignores the target’s stat modifiers, including evasion.
chip-away.flavor:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

chloroblast.flavor: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user.

circle-throw.effect:
Inflicts regular damage, then switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon, selected at random.

If the target is under the effect of Ingrain or Suction Cups, or it has a Substitute, or its Trainer has no more usable Pokémon, it will not be switched out.  If the target is a wild Pokémon, the battle ends instead.
circle-throw.flavor: The target is thrown, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

clamp.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn.  The user continues to use other moves during this time.  If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times.  Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.
clamp.flavor:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

clanging-scales.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Lowers the user’s Defense by one stage.
clanging-scales.flavor: The user rubs the scales on its entire body and makes a huge noise to attack opposing Pokémon. The user's Defense stat is lowered after the attack.

clangorous-soul.effect: User loses 33% of its Max HP. Raises all of the user’s stats by one stage. Fails if the user would faint, or if its Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, or Speed stat cannot go any higher.
clangorous-soul.flavor: The user boosts all its stats by using some of its own HP.

clangorous-soulblaze.effect: Inflicts sound-based damage to all opposing Pokémon and increases the user’s Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each. The user’s stats are not raised if the move fails to damage any opposing Pokémon.
clangorous-soulblaze.flavor:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

clear-smog.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  All of the target’s stat modifiers are reset to zero.
clear-smog.flavor: The user attacks the target by throwing a clump of special mud. All stat changes are eliminated.

close-combat.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.
close-combat.flavor: The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.

coaching.effect: Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.
coaching.flavor: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

coil.effect: Raises the user’s Attack, Defense, and accuracy by one stage each.
coil.flavor: The user coils up and concentrates. This boosts its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.

collision-course.flavor: The user transforms and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times.  Averages to 3 hits per use.
comet-punch.flavor:
This move can’t be used.

comeuppance.flavor: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.

confide.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
confide.flavor: The user tells the target a secret, and the target loses its ability to concentrate. This lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

confuse-ray.flavor: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that causes confusion.

confusion.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to confuse the target.
confusion.flavor: The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also confuse the target.

conversion.effect: User’s type changes to the type of one of its moves, selected at random.  Hidden Power and Weather Ball are treated as Normal.  Only moves with a different type are eligible, and Curse is never eligible.  If the user has no suitable moves, this move will fail.
conversion.flavor: The user changes its type to become the same type as the move at the top of the list of moves it knows.

conversion-2.effect: Changes the user’s type to a type either resistant or immune to the last damaging move that hit it.  The new type is selected at random and cannot be a type the user already is.  If there is no eligible new type, this move will fail.
conversion-2.flavor: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the move the target used last.

copycat.effect:
Uses the last move that was used successfully by any Pokémon, including the user.

This move cannot copy itself, nor Roar nor Whirlwind.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.
copycat.flavor: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.

core-enforcer.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target has already moved this turn, its ability is nullified.
core-enforcer.flavor:
If the Pokémon the user has inflicted damage on
have already used their moves, this move eliminates
the effect of the target’s Ability.

corkscrew-crash--physical.flavor:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

corkscrew-crash--special.flavor:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

corrosive-gas.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Target loses its held item.

Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle.

If the target has Multitype or Sticky Hold, it will take damage but not lose its item.
corrosive-gas.flavor:
The user surrounds everything around it with
highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.

cosmic-power.effect: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.
cosmic-power.flavor: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to boost its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

cotton-guard.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by three stages.
cotton-guard.flavor: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, drastically boosting its Defense stat.

cotton-spore.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.
cotton-spore.flavor: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to opposing Pokémon. This harshly lowers their Speed stats.

counter.effect:
Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a physical move this turn.  Inflicts twice the damage that move did to the user.  If there is no eligible target, this move will fail.  Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.
counter.flavor: A retaliatory attack that counters any physical move, inflicting double the damage taken.

court-change.effect: Switches the Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Spikes, Safeguard, Tailwind, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, Water Pledge, Fire Pledge, Grass Pledge, Sticky Web, Aurora Veil, G-Max Steelsurge, G-Max Cannonade, G-Max Vine Lash, and G-Max Wildfire effects from the user's side to the opposing side and vice versa.
court-change.flavor: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.

covet.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the target is holding an item and the user is not, the user will permanently take the item.  Damage is still inflicted if an item cannot be taken.

Pokémon with Sticky Hold or Multitype are immune to the item theft effect.

The target cannot recover its item with Recycle.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.
covet.flavor: The user endearingly approaches the target, then steals the target's held item.

crabhammer.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.
crabhammer.flavor: The target is hammered with a large pincer. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

crafty-shield.effect:
Protects all friendly Pokémon from non-damaging moves for the rest of the turn.

Unlike other blocking moves, this move may be used consecutively without its chance of success falling.
crafty-shield.flavor:
The user protects itself and its allies from status
moves with a mysterious power. This does not stop
moves that do damage.

cross-chop.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.
cross-chop.flavor: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

cross-poison.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a chance to poison the target.
cross-poison.flavor: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also poison the target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

crunch.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
crunch.flavor: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

crush-claw.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
crush-claw.flavor: The user slashes the target with hard and sharp claws. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

crush-grip.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Power directly relates to the target’s relative remaining HP, given by `1 + 120 * current HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 121.
crush-grip.flavor: The target is crushed with great force. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.
